g.text: Complete Hardware Interconnect Map Matching 3D Enclosure Internal Assembly (Rev 2.1 Precision Aligned)
Each has 330Ω series resistor to GND
PHYSICAL WIRE SPECIFICATIONS & ENCLOSURE ASSEMBLY GUIDE:
• 220V AC Power Harness (Mains Entry → Fuse → Relays → ACS712 → Outlets):
Use 16 AWG or 18 AWG stranded copper wire (rated 300V/600V, 105°C).
• Low-Voltage 5V DC Bus (HLK-5M05 → ESP32, Relays, Sensors):
Use 22 AWG hookup wire. Solder 470µF electrolytic cap directly across 5V and GND.
• Microcontroller Logic & Sensor Signals (GPIO to Relays, ACS712, ZMPT101B, mmWave):
Use standard 2.54mm pitch DuPont jumper wires (keep lengths under 15 cm for low noise).
Mount HLK-LD2410C on front enclosure wall (facing room center) away from 220V AC relays.
